description: This file defines the interface UnivariateStatistic for statistical computations on univariate data, including methods to evaluate the statistic over arrays and to create copies.

classes.name: UnivariateStatistic
classes.description: Interface for univariate statistical computations, supporting evaluation over arrays and copying.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the statistic over the entire input array.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the statistic over a specified subarray.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the statistic with the same internal state.
